stem.en: How is the gradient of a scalar field oriented relative to that field's level surfaces?
stem.et: Kuidas on skalaarvälja gradient orienteeritud selle välja nivoopindade suhtes?

label.en: Always perpendicular to the level surface passing through that point
label.et: Alati risti selles punktis läbiva nivoopinnaga

label.en: Always tangent to the level surface, lying within it
label.et: Alati puutuja nivoopinnaga, asudes selle sees

label.en: Pointing in the direction of steepest decrease
In an arbitrary direction, unrelated to the level surfaces
